sources.title: grug-27b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The special Q4 quantization variant (grug-27b-qat-q4-gguf) was trained from v1 weights and has not been refreshed for v2.1 improvements. If you need Q4 quantization with maximum quality, you get v1 reasoning behavior, not the latest v2.1 adaptive depth.
